--8<-- [start:memoization_recipe]
-dynamic(FibCache/2)

Fib(0, 0),
Fib(1, 1),
Fib(N, F) <- (
    N > 1,
    N1 is N - 1,
    N2 is N - 2,
    Fib(N1, F1),
    Fib(N2, F2),
    F is F1 + F2,
    assertz(FibCache(N, F))
)
--8<-- [end:memoization_recipe]

--8<-- [start:counter_recipe]
-dynamic(Ctr/1)

Ctr(0),

Increment(NEW) <- (
    retract(Ctr(OLD)),
    NEW is OLD + 1,
    assertz(Ctr(NEW))
)

Test("counter") <- (
    Increment(1),
    Increment(2),
    Ctr(2)
)
--8<-- [end:counter_recipe]

--8<-- [start:collect_recipe]
-dynamic(Result/1)

CollectEvens(LIST) <- (
    in_(X, LIST),
    X % 2 == 0,
    assertz(Result(X)),
    False
)
CollectEvens(_),
--8<-- [end:collect_recipe]
